headline: China Diesel Exports Forecast to Decline in November
summary: Chinese diesel exports are expected to fall in November as domestic inventories tighten following high shipment volumes in August and September. Refiners have sold approximately 500,000 metric tons for November loading so far.
why: China is one of the world's largest oil refiners and a key exporter of refined petroleum products. Changes in its export policy significantly impact global diesel supply and pricing dynamics.

impacts.name: Diesel
impacts.why: Reduced export supply from a major producer typically exerts upward pressure on global diesel prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A reduction in export volume from a major global supplier like China typically tightens international supply, which can lead to higher prices for refined petroleum products.
